verses.ar: أَمْثَالُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ مَلِكِ إِسْرَائِيلَ:
verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.web: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

verses.ar: لِمَعْرِفَةِ حِكْمَةٍ وَأَدَبٍ. لِإِدْرَاكِ أَقْوَالِ ٱلْفَهْمِ.
verses.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.web: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

verses.ar: لِقُبُولِ تَأْدِيبِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ وَٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

verses.ar: لِتُعْطِيَ ٱلْجُهَّالَ ذَكَاءً، وَٱلشَّابَّ مَعْرِفَةً وَتَدَبُّرًا.
verses.kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.web: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

verses.ar: يَسْمَعُهَا ٱلْحَكِيمُ فَيَزْدَادُ عِلْمًا، وَٱلْفَهِيمُ يَكْتَسِبُ تَدْبِيرًا.
verses.kjv: A wise [man] will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

verses.ar: لِفَهْمِ ٱلْمَثَلِ وَٱللُّغْزِ، أَقْوَالِ ٱلْحُكَمَاءِ وَغَوَامِضِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.web: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

verses.ar: مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ رَأْسُ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ، أَمَّا ٱلْجَاهِلُونَ فَيَحْتَقِرُونَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلْأَدَبَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge: [but] fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.ar: اِسْمَعْ يَا ٱبْنِي تَأْدِيبَ أَبِيكَ، وَلَا تَرْفُضْ شَرِيعَةَ أُمِّكَ،
verses.kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.web: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمَا إِكْلِيلُ نِعْمَةٍ لِرَأْسِكَ، وَقَلَائِدُ لِعُنُقِكَ.
verses.kjv: For they [shall be] an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.web: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، إِنْ تَمَلَّقَكَ ٱلْخُطَاةُ فَلَا تَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

verses.ar: إِنْ قَالُوا: «هَلُمَّ مَعَنَا لِنَكْمُنْ لِلدَّمِ. لِنَخْتَفِ لِلْبَرِيءِ بَاطِلًا.
verses.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.web: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

verses.ar: لِنَبْتَلِعْهُمْ أَحْيَاءً كَٱلْهَاوِيَةِ، وَصِحَاحًا كَٱلْهَابِطِينَ فِي ٱلْجُبِّ،
verses.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.web: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

verses.ar: فَنَجِدَ كُلَّ قِنْيَةٍ فَاخِرَةٍ، نَمْلَأَ بُيُوتَنَا غَنِيمَةً.
verses.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.web: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

verses.ar: تُلْقِي قُرْعَتَكَ وَسْطَنَا. يَكُونُ لَنَا جَمِيعًا كِيسٌ وَاحِدٌ».
verses.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.web: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، لَا تَسْلُكْ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ مَعَهُمْ. اِمْنَعْ رِجْلَكَ عَنْ مَسَالِكِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.web: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَرْجُلَهُمْ تَجْرِي إِلَى ٱلشَّرِّ وَتُسْرِعُ إِلَى سَفْكِ ٱلدَّمِ.
verses.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.web: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ بَاطِلًا تُنْصَبُ ٱلشَّبَكَةُ فِي عَيْنَيْ كُلِّ ذِي جَنَاحٍ.
verses.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.web: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

verses.ar: أَمَّا هُمْ فَيَكْمُنُونَ لِدَمِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ. يَخْتَفُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: And they lay wait for their [own] blood; they lurk privily for their [own] lives.
verses.web: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

verses.ar: هَكَذَا طُرُقُ كُلِّ مُولَعٍ بِكَسْبٍ. يَأْخُذُ نَفْسَ مُقْتَنِيهِ.
verses.kjv: So [are] the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; [which] taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.web: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

verses.ar: اَلْحِكْمَةُ تُنَادِي فِي ٱلْخَارِجِ. فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ تُعْطِي صَوْتَهَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.web: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

verses.ar: تَدْعُو فِي رُؤُوسِ ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ، فِي مَدَاخِلِ ٱلْأَبْوَابِ. فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تُبْدِي كَلَامَهَا
verses.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, [saying],
verses.web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

verses.ar: قَائِلَةً: «إِلَى مَتَى أَيُّهَا ٱلْجُهَّالُ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْجَهْلَ، وَٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئُونَ يُسَرُّونَ بِٱلِٱسْتِهْزَاءِ، وَٱلْحَمْقَى يُبْغِضُونَ ٱلْعِلْمَ؟
verses.kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.web: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.ar: اِرْجِعُوا عِنْدَ تَوْبِيخِي. هَأَنَذَا أُفِيضُ لَكُمْ رُوحِي. أُعَلِّمُكُمْ كَلِمَاتِي.
verses.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

verses.ar: «لِأَنِّي دَعَوْتُ فَأَبَيْتُمْ، وَمَدَدْتُ يَدِي وَلَيْسَ مَنْ يُبَالِي،
verses.kjv: ¶ Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.web: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

verses.ar: بَلْ رَفَضْتُمْ كُلَّ مَشُورَتِي، وَلَمْ تَرْضَوْا تَوْبِيخِي.
verses.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

verses.ar: فَأَنَا أَيْضًا أَضْحَكُ عِنْدَ بَلِيَّتِكُمْ. أَشْمَتُ عِنْدَ مَجِيءِ خَوْفِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

verses.ar: إِذَا جَاءَ خَوْفُكُمْ كَعَاصِفَةٍ، وَأَتَتْ بَلِيَّتُكُمْ كَٱلزَّوْبَعَةِ، إِذَا جَاءَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ شِدَّةٌ وَضِيقٌ.
verses.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ يَدْعُونَنِي فَلَا أَسْتَجِيبُ. يُبَكِّرُونَ إِلَيَّ فَلَا يَجِدُونَنِي.
verses.kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.web: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ أَبْغَضُوا ٱلْعِلْمَ وَلَمْ يَخْتَارُوا مَخَافَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.web: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

verses.ar: لَمْ يَرْضَوْا مَشُورَتِي. رَذَلُوا كُلَّ تَوْبِيخِي.
verses.kjv: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.web: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

verses.ar: فَلِذَلِكَ يَأْكُلُونَ مِنْ ثَمَرِ طَرِيقِهِمْ، وَيَشْبَعُونَ مِنْ مُؤَامَرَاتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.web: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱرْتِدَادَ ٱلْحَمْقَى يَقْتُلُهُمْ، وَرَاحَةَ ٱلْجُهَّالِ تُبِيدُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.web: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْمُسْتَمِعُ لِي فَيَسْكُنُ آمِنًا، وَيَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْ خَوْفِ ٱلشَّرِّ».
verses.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
